name: TASUKI Holdings Inc.
summary: TASUKI Holdings Inc. operates in real estate in Japan. Its Life Platform handles planning, development and sale of IoT-enabled homes, logistics facilities and other properties, together with investment and asset management solutions. It also offers real estate secured loans, owner consulting, crowdfunding, fund management and vacant property renovation and resale, and develops DX products for the industry. It dates from 2024 in Tokyo.
